name: omniview-looking-glass
description: An agent-operated wormhole camera for grounded views through place and time.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-operated views through place and time.
interface.longDescription: Ground a place-time, open a physically coherent viewpoint, compose the material scene, and produce or render a high-density image prompt with honest evidence and tool receipts.
capabilities: High-density image prompts and optional host renders
defaultPrompt: Open a view onto Uruk around 3200 BC at first light.
Show me this point in Pripyat in 1985 and 2020.
Give me a render prompt for Point Nemo in AD 1500.
